name: clamp-retry
prompt: There is a bug in `clampRetries(requested)` in retry.js. It must return a whole number of retries from 0 to 10 inclusive: values above 10 become 10 (including Infinity), values below 0 become 0 (including -Infinity), a fractional part is dropped (2.9 becomes 2), and NaN becomes 0. Right now it only caps the top end. Fix retry.js so that test/retry.test.js passes. Use only the Node.js standard library and do not modify the test.
context: A dependency-free CommonJS package. Run `node --test` to check your work.
